config.notes: Collarts course pages (www.collarts.edu.au/courses/...) cover a Diploma and Bachelor (several CRICOS codes, printed as CRICOS Code a/b/c). Each page prints a Local view then an International view; header items STUDY MODES, NEXT INTAKE, LOCATION and duration appear in both, so pick last = International view. Only the NEXT intake is printed (e.g. September 2026), not the full set. International fees are per UNIT and COURSE TOTAL only - no annual fee, so no fee pattern. No IELTS on course pages: central rule on /study-information/international-students/ (IELTS 6.0, no band below 6.0; Entertainment Journalism 6.5, no band below 6.0). Trimesters from /study-information/key-dates/: Trimester 1 = February, Trimester 2 = June, Trimester 3 = September.
